name: BSP_CreditsScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 5Ch screen at 00E198AC+68h. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CED200 at +00h and 00CED1E0 at +08h, zeroes +28h..+30h and +50h..+58h, and seeds +3Ch, +40h and +44h from the rdata constants 00CED1DC, 00CE3800 and 00CED1D8. Slot +00h of 00CED200 is 0052FD60, a 'mov eax,8; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 8 = INTF_CREDITS. Register override 0052FFC0 binds FE_credits and reads Scripts/datatables/Credits.lua through Credits, Credits_Items, RowSpace, StartY and Speed. Its enter virtual 0052EE30 is one of the six callers of 00A867B0, so it is the screen that opens the manager +48h path sound/music/creditsfinal.fsb. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.
